caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects placed on a rectangular wooden plank. On the left, there is a hollow, horizontally oriented cylindrical log with an additional vertical section attached to its upper side, featuring a circular opening on one end and a smaller hole on its side. The wood shows a natural, light brown color with visible grain lines and some cracks. To the right of the cylinder, there is a second object resembling a thick rod or handle with deep, evenly spaced grooves along its length, and it terminates in a solid circular end with a metal crank handle inserted into it. The crank handle has a dark wooden grip attached to a bent metal rod. Both objects are rendered in shades of brown, with the grain and texture of the wood carefully detailed. The background is a plain, light beige color devoid of any additional elements.
title: Potato Grinder
